messages:
jon: Heads-up — planning a three-way bump (API / runtime / console) tonight. Need a quick handshake on pin windows and sdk mirrors.

maria: Cutoff ETA?

jon: Targeting 22:00 UTC. Canaries at 21:30. Rollout 22:00–22:20. If you can’t meet the pin, call it early.

kevin: Runtime has a small ABI tweak around kv-cache headers, I’ll add a compat shim. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/512 :eyes:

sophia: Console requires the header change too. I can land console PR if runtime canary is up.

maria: SDKs: I’ll cut js-sdk release after tags exist. Will hold minor semver bump if we need a follow-up patch.

jon: Quick checklist (agree?):
1) runtime PR merged + canary tag @ 21:30 UTC
2) api PR merged + tag @ 21:40 UTC
3) console PR merged + tag @ 21:50 UTC
4) js-sdk cut @ 22:00 UTC

kevin: Fine. I’ll push runtime canary at 21:28 to give 2m verification.

sophia: Console PR is green locally. Will wait for kevin’s canary then trigger console canary.

release-bot: Deploy queued: runtime/canary -> build #9783. CI: https://ci.redwood/9783

qa-bot: Kicking smoke tests against runtime/canary when build finishes (~6m). I’ll post failures as separate threads.

maria: Changelog note for console (draft): "console: align /models header with runtime kv-cache (backwards compatible)." I’ll paste final blurb before tag.

jon: If anything slips, hold the SDK cut and we do a patch tomorrow. Otherwise proceed. Please react with :thumbsup: when you’re green.

kevin: :thumbsup:

sophia: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:
